properties.summary: Land-use districts of the City of Concord's adopted Concord Reuse Project Area Plan (2012, part of the General Plan), traced from Book One Figure 3-3 and clipped to the Navy's Economic Development Conveyance property. The Area Plan covers about 5,046 acres, including the future regional park outside this site. Streets and creeks drawn over the districts are folded into the nearest one; neighborhood parks and plazas (not mapped by the plan) and the developer's unadopted 2026 concept plan aren't drawn. About 115 acres of the site have no district on the diagram (mainly the SR-4 / BART corridor strip) and are left blank. Zones, not buildings; all boundaries approximate.
properties.note: Land-use districts from the adopted 2012 Area Plan; the Specific Plan is next. Approximate zones, not buildings.

controls.label: arterial and freeway centrelines vs OpenStreetMap: trimmed RMS over the closest 70% of 4642 points

georeference.note: Figure 3-3 fitted to its existing arterials and freeways (vector road centrelines) against OpenStreetMap by trimmed ICP from a three-BART-station start: about 17.9 m per figure point, rotation 1.5 deg, trimmed RMS 4 m (90% of road points within 14 m). The diagram is drawn at about 1:51,000, so district edges are generalised by tens of metres. Zones clipped to the EDC property boundary.

properties.license: Zone shapes: traced from a public City of Concord plan. Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.label: North Concord TOD core
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Region-serving mixed-use employment centre by North Concord BART: Class A offices, shops, services, plazas; housing optional up to 20 du/gross acre (60-150 du/net acre), FAR 2.0-4.0 (Table 3-4, p. 44). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~700 homes and 3,000,000 sq ft commercial. About 28 acres on the EDC property as drawn (50 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~55 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: North Concord TOD neighborhood
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Mixed-use residential district within walking distance of BART: 20-30 du/gross acre (18-100 du/net acre), FAR 1.0-3.0, with local retail, a grocery store and community facilities (Table 3-4, p. 44). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~2,200 homes and 150,000 sq ft commercial. Category residential: the plan calls it a mixed-use residential district. About 79 acres on the EDC property as drawn (85 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~90 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Central neighborhood
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Mixed-use residential district at moderate densities: 15-20 du/gross acre (14-50 du/net acre), low- to mid-rise (Table 3-4, p. 45). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~2,600 homes and 100,000 sq ft commercial. About 177 acres on the EDC property as drawn (177 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~180 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Village center
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Main-street centres anchoring the village neighborhoods: multi-unit housing, retail and community facilities, 5-20 du/gross acre (18-50 du/net acre), FAR 0.5-2.0 (Table 3-4, p. 45). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~500 homes and 350,000 sq ft commercial. About 66 acres on the EDC property as drawn (67 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~70 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Village neighborhood
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Residential districts at moderate to low densities: 8-12 du/gross acre (6-45 du/net acre), attached and detached homes (Table 3-4, p. 46). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~6,200 homes. About 789 acres on the EDC property as drawn (799 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~740 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Commercial flex
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Region-serving retail and/or workplace district: R&D/flex, light industrial, office and retail, FAR 0.2-1.0, no housing (Table 3-4, p. 46). Table 3-2 (p. 40): ~1,700,000 sq ft. Category commercial: the plan lists it under Commercial. About 210 acres on the EDC property as drawn (226 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~210 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Campus
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
properties.note: Educational, research and development, health-care and/or cultural uses; up to 800,000 sq ft for any use besides a four-year campus (Table 3-4, p. 47). Category civic: the plan lists it under Civic and Institutional. About 118 acres on the EDC property as drawn (122 acres across the plan area as traced; Table 3-2 gives ~120 planning-area-wide). Approximate boundary: traced from a small-scale plan diagram.

properties.label: Conservation open space

properties.label: Greenways, citywide parks and tournament facilities
properties.source: traced: Concord Reuse Project Area Plan, Book One: Vision and Standards (City of Concord, adopted Jan 24, 2012), Figure 3-3, Area Plan Diagram, p. 41 (PDF p. 49)
